children.text: 5 Commendation: Clerics of Amaunator adds Amaunator's Blessing
children.tooltip: Amaunator's Blessing: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.

children.text: 5 Commendation: Druids of the King's Forest adds Woodsman's Guile
children.tooltip: Woodsman's Guile: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +4 bonus to your To-Hit and +6 bonus to your Damage on any attack that would be considered a Sneak Attack.

children.text: 5 Commendation: Purple Dragon Knights adds Knight's Loyalty
children.tooltip: Knight's Loyalty: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +3 artifact bonus to your To-Hit and Damage rolls, and a +3 Insight bonus to Natural Armor.

children.text: 5 Commendation: Villagers of Eveningstar adds Way of the Sun Soul
children.tooltip: Way of the Sun Soul: When all three item from the set are equipped and you are in a centered state, you will gain +2 artifact bonus to To-Hit and Damage rolls. In addition, when you roll a natural 20 on an attack roll that is confirmed as a critical hit, you will gain temporary benefit based on the elemental stance you are in, if any.

children.tooltip: Battle Arcanist: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.
